Section 179w of Title 2 of the United States Code is the effective date section for the National Film Registry laws. Those laws, sections 179l to 179w, govern the naming of films to the registry.

The section states how widely the scheme applies. It reaches any copy of any film, without exception. Copies of films chosen under two older acts are expressly included. They are the National Film Preservation Act of 1988 and the act of 1992. A legal bridge then treats those older choices as choices under the new sections. Any film so selected is deemed selected for the registry under this scheme.
